# hue_device (Resource)

Manage the name and archetype of an already paired device. Creation adopts an existing device by UUID; it never pairs hardware. Destroy only removes Terraform management, leaving the device and its settings unchanged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hue_device" "desk" {
  device_id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
  name      = "Desk"
  archetype = "table_shade"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) UUID of an already paired device, not a light service UUID. Changes replace only the Terraform management binding.

### Optional

- `archetype` (String) Device product archetype used for its icon. Omitted values are preserved; supported values depend on the Bridge.
- `name` (String) Device name (1–32 characters). Omitted names are preserved.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Device UUID.
- `light_ids` (Set of String) UUIDs of light services owned by this device, suitable for scene actions and zone children. Empty for devices without lights. Use one(light_ids) only for devices with exactly one light service.
